label: Galotyri
note: Greek PDO of Epirus and Thessaly; counted as neither cheese nor yoghurt; the industrial version uses a yoghurt starter, artisan ones sour naturally and are ripened.

about.text: Galotyri is a Greek PDO acid-curd, soft spreadable cheese made in Epirus and Thessaly from boiled, naturally acidified ewe milk or ewe and goat milk. It is thick and creamy, with at least 40 % fat in dry matter, at most 75 % moisture and pH 4 to 4.5.
